highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 with refreshed rendering fixes and updated native text shaping.
highlights_body: RAW and DNG image decoding is no longer included, and GLES interop now uses pointer-based signatures. Review these changes before adopting the preview.

breaking.title: RAW and DNG decoding removed
breaking.body: RAW and DNG image decoding is no longer available. Convert those assets to a supported format before decoding them with SkiaSharp.

breaking.title: GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures
breaking.body: GLES interop now uses pointer-based signatures. Update native interop call sites to pass the expected pointers.

bullets.detail: Refreshes the bundled renderer with Skia m155 and its servicing fixes.
Native GLES interop now accepts pointers, aligning the bindings with the underlying API.
Removes support for decoding RAW and DNG images from the bundled native library.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the 4.155 line with the Skia m155 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 added m155 servicing fixes, updated HarfBuzz, and the GLES interop and image-decoding changes.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Release Candidate 1 refreshed the bundled engine with the final m155 servicing fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz text-shaping engine to version 14.4.0.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m155 rendering engine.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 2 refreshes the m155 engine and text shaping.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: It also updates GLES interop and removes RAW and DNG image decoding.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Release Candidate 1 includes the final m155 servicing updates.
